'''Trainees''' were the lowest rank in the [[Alanciari military]], which was the defense force of the [[Alanciari]]. The Alanciari were a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] civilization, whom inhabited the continent of [[Alanciar]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Following the arrival of the Keshiri exile [[Adari Vaal]] in [[4975 BBY]], the Alanciari had developed a militaristic civilization which was designed to resist any invasion by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] living on the neighboring continent of [[Keshtah Minor]]. Trainees consisted of both male and female Keshiri youth who were conscripted between the ages of twelve and fifteen. Several trainees participated in the defense of Alanciar during the Sith [[invasion of Alanciar]] in [[2975 BBY]].
